pillarsHeading.title: The Four Core Pillars of Combat

pillars.title: Adugulu (అడుగులు)
pillars.subtitle: Triangular Combat Footwork
pillars.desc: The sacred geometry of grounding. Rapid weight shifts, directional pivots, and evasive stepping inspired by tiger and eagle stances.

pillars.title: Karra (కర్ర)
pillars.subtitle: Centrifugal Staff Velocity
pillars.desc: Mastery of the 6-foot bamboo staff. Generating continuous circular momentum to form a 360-degree kinetic forcefield around the warrior.

pillars.title: Talwar & Dhal (కత్తి & డాలు)
pillars.subtitle: Royal Sword & Brass Shield
pillars.desc: Historical battlefield blade forms, cutting arcs, thrusting lines, and solid brass shield deflections codified in royal garadis.

pillars.title: Veera Poru (వీర పోరు)
pillars.subtitle: Authentic Warrior Sparring
pillars.desc: Real-time combat reaction inside the training arena. Pressure testing rhythm, distance judgment, and weapon disarming with zero malice.

guruFeature.name: Guru Sri Vijay Kumar Kalidasu
guruFeature.role: Chief Master & Trainer, Andhra Art Of War
guruFeature.heading: Preserving the Sacred Breath of Karrasamu
guruFeature.quote: "In Karrasamu, the staff is not held to subjugate an enemy; it is spun to illuminate the undisciplined mind. When the weapon flies at full velocity, there is zero space for pride or hesitation."
guruFeature.description: Led by Chief Guru & Trainer Vijay Kumar Kalidasu, Andhra Art Of War continues the unbroken transmission from foundational Grandmaster Sri Boddu Ramadasu (1898–1974), ensuring that the ancient oral rhythms and akhada conditioning remain alive for generations to come.

enrollSection.description: Classes are conducted in the Ghantasala Music Collage, sanctified under the divine feet of Goddess Sri Kanaka Durga in Vijayawada. Open to all aspiring practitioners aged 5 and above no prior experience required.
